notes.title: "Soul Dossier" Update Announcement on September 19th
notes.content:
[p]"Soul Dossier" Update Announcement on September 19th



Dear agent

The server of "Soul Dossier" will undergo maintenance at 10:30 on September 19th (UTC+8), which is expected to last for 180 minutes. During the maintenance period, all agents will not be able to log in to the game. Please arrange your time reasonably to avoid unnecessary losses, agents! The server opening time may be advanced or postponed depending on the actual situation. Thank you all for your understanding and support.



▶ Maintenance compensation ◀

Spirit Coins x 10,000, Ancient Coins x500, Good Luck Treasure Box x1, Forget Worry Wine X 1, Double Spirit Coin Cards X 3

All agents, please claim it through the game email. Please pay attention to the claim time



"Function Adjustment

The voiceover for the simulated Ghost character Bai Qiulian has been updated



"2V8 mode launched

Opening hours: 19:30-23:30 every night (Matching mode)

Ten players will be divided into two (Ghost) and eight (Human) to compete against each other. There are a total of 8 players on the Human side. They need to seal 3 array eyes 5 times to win. There are 2 players on the Ghost side. They need to devour the souls of all Human characters or knock them down to win.

This mode has special rules as follows:

I. Soul Devouring

The Five Elements attributes of the Human will no longer affect the order of soul devouring, but only the therapeutic effect.

2. Ghost cannot devour the soul of the spirit scout character based on the Five Elements attributes. Only the Human who fell to the ground due to the loss of 7 spirits can have their souls devoured.

After receiving a normal attack, the Human will obtain a buff effect of invincibility and invincibility, which lasts for 2 seconds.

Ii. Array Eye Sealing

In this mode, by default, each array eye needs to be sealed five times to complete the sealing of that array eye.

2. Youdaoplaceholder0 eye refreshes at the beginning of the game

Iii. Selection of Magic Tricks

The two Ghost are respectively the Ghost of position 1 and the Ghost of position 2:

The Ghost in position 1 can carry a sealing-type magic spell

The Ghost in position 2 can carry cursed spells

Both Ghost can carry their exclusive magic tricks



"Exclusive Rotation of the Selected Treasure Chest"

Event Time: September 5, 2025 - September 19, 2025

• Exclusive skin for this issue's selected treasure box: "Luoli - Butterfly Shadow Flowing Light" is waiting for you!

• This issue's selected treasure box can be exchanged for skins and items: "Luoli - Butterfly Shadow Flowing Light", "Youyue - Flower Fairy · Frost White Oath", "Xiang Nuannuan - Flower Fairy · Purple Crystal Dream", "Shen Wanyin - Flower Fairy · Ice Blue Flowing Light", "Lin Muhan - Mist Crow · Manli", "Wei Qingyu - Immortal Feather Brocade · Clear"



"Theme Treasure Box: Little Flower Fairies

"Little flower fairy, with charming dreams fluttering." "

Event Time: After version update - October 17, 2025

The Little Flower Fairy series of costumes can be drawn from the Little Flower Fairy themed treasure Chest.

During the event period, collect all the costumes of a single character and you can exchange them for exclusive items for free.



Monthly Active Event: Xiao Qiang's Comeback

Xiao Qiang's Fashion Comeback: From the Kitchen to the Spiritual Realm.

Event time: After version update - October 17, 2025

During the event period, completing active tasks can earn you "Qin Qiang - Cosplay Xiao Qiang" and "He Ruoyao - Hate Xiao Qiang".



"Monthly Bible

Version update -2025/10/10

Consume 3,900 spirit stones to unlock the Treasure Book quest. Complete the quest to obtain game rewards such as "Li Xiaotu - Pink Pattern Suit" and 2,900 spirit stones!



"Limited-time Cumulative Recharge: A Thousand Autumns

Event time: After version update - October 17, 2025

During the event period, you can receive a cumulative recharge reward by recharging a specified amount.

Recharge 1000, 3000, 5000, or 8000 to get free fashion rewards of the corresponding levels!

The amount of character gift packs purchased directly from Steam will not be included in the progress of the event.



"Direct Sales Page: Starfall · Yaoguang

"Stars set to cut the clouds and brocade, and the rosy light reflects on the rosy glow.

"Bai Gu - Xing Luo · Yao Guang" and "Xiao Li - Xing Luo · Yao Guang" can be purchased directly on the page. The original price is 1,288,000 pieces of jade, and the discounted price is 880,000 pieces of jade.



"Return of Star Diamonds

Event Time: September 19, 2025/- October 10, 2025/

During the event period, "Xiang Nuan Nuan - Flowing Light Fairy" will return for a limited time. You can exchange corresponding costumes, back accessories and actions through the Star Diamond Mall.



"Double Festival Cumulative Consumption Activity"

The country and the family celebrate the full moon together, and consumers offer gifts to celebrate the double festivals.

Event Time: After version update -2025/10/9 23:59:59

During the event period, if the cumulative consumption of spirit stones reaches the designated amount, the corresponding level of rewards can be unlocked

1. Spend more, enjoy more. Rewards can be accumulated and claimed, with the highest value return reaching over 100%



"New Arrivals at Jihuan Pavilion

"Youyue - Lily of the Valley Fairy · Yelan & Wei Qingyu - Lily of the Valley Fairy · Xuancai/Taoyao" series



"Secret Silver Mall Rotation

"Secret silver weaving gifts, warm enjoyment of honey affection.

The new skins and items added to this issue's Secret Silver Mall are:

"Ling Zhengying - Weiqing Yu", "Wei Qingyu - Yunchu Lu", "Nalan - Meiying Jiaomo", "Nan Gong Yichen - Summer Coolness · Ice Blue"

"Xiao Bing - Rui Xue Lu Qing · Yin Frost", "Bai Xue - Jin Ying Zhui Guang", "Ba Chi - Devil", "Lei Zhen Zi - Ni Hong Zi"

"Yu Ji - The Battle between Heaven and Man - Bloody Slaughter of the Enemy" "Xiao Zhu - The Fairy Tale of Seeking the Nest"



"Ah Zi & Guess"

The detailed rules and rewards of "A Zi Guess" can be viewed on the "A Zi Guess" interface

1. Event period: After version update - October 10, 2025. The rock-paper-scissors tickets will be cleared after the end of this event before the update!

2. Activity Benefits: You can get one "Rock-Paper-Scissors Ticket" and one "Refresh Ticket" for free on the activity page every day.



"【 Problem Fixed

The performance of some points on the map and within the game has been optimized



Lingjinghutong feedback form: [url="https://wj.qq.com/s2/21398468/d92b/"]https://wj.qq.com/s2/21398468/d92b/[/url] (we will be distributed according to quality feedback numismatics reward)



Contact the Q11 group: 854043103

Communicate with Q12 Group: 904065208

Lingjing Video Creation Group: 937928948

Lingjing Live Streaming Group: 902157316[/p]

tags.balance_change: - Slightly increased the amount of HP restored to the Psychic Detective during the main star skill period when Luo Fang is affected.
- Slightly reduced the duration required to obtain items while in pursuit mode during the activation of the main star skill.
- Slightly increased attack range
- Slightly reduced the duration of the thunderstorm cloud released by Skill 2

tags.feature: 1. Map - The GKD office has been optimized. A small room around the core has been adjusted and a new small passage ("dog hole") has been added.

tags.bug: 1. Fixed the issue where Li Xiaotu, the Spirit Detective, would be unable to pass through obstacles after using her main star skill to shrink while crouching under an obstacle.
2. Fixed the issue where the Simulated Ghost, Bada, would become visible after being pushed against a wall by Luo Li's main star skill within her domain skill.
3. Fixed the issue where there was no progress reminder when successfully sealing a fragment of the Bagua Array during a match.
4. Fixed the issue where the bean soldiers summoned by Ouyang Miaomiao's main star skill would not actively dismantle the thunder cones of the Simulated Ghost, Leizhenzi.

5. Fixed the issue where Jia Hui would lose her soul when attacked by Nie Xiaoqian's 3rd skill, Yang Qilang's 1st and 2nd skills, and Leizhenzi's 2nd skill during the pre-cast period of her main star skill.
6. Fixed the issue where some portals on the map would have a chance of not functioning properly for teleportation.

notes.title: Update Notice of "Mirage Tales" on August 29th
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Update Notice of "Mirage Tales" on August 29th [/p][p][/p][p]Dear Agents,[/p][p][/p][p]The server of "Spirit Realm Tales" will undergo maintenance at 12:30 on August 29th (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 180 minutes. During this period, all agents will be unable to log in to the game. Please arrange your time accordingly to avoid any unnecessary losses. The server's reopening time may be earlier or later depending on the actual situation. We appreciate your understanding and support. [/p][p][/p][p]▶ Maintenance Compensation ◀[/p][p]10,000 Spirit Coins, 500 Ancient Coins, 1 Lucky Treasure Chest, 1 Forget Worry Wine, 3 Double Spirit Coin Cards[/p][p]Please claim them via in-game mail, and remember to check within the specified time. [/p][p][/p][p]【Balance Adjustment】[/p][p]<Spirit Detective>[/p][p]• Jia Hui[/p][p]- Slightly increased the armor value Jia Hui has in the Seven Kill state.[/p][p]• Na Lan Lian Wu[/p][p]- Slightly reduced the stamina cost of using the main star skill.[/p][p]• Nan Gong Yi Chen[/p][p]- Optimized the size of the interaction box, making it easier to interact with the main star skill's flying sword.[/p][p]• Shen Wan Yin[/p][p]- During the burrowing period, she is considered to be in a crouching state.[/p][p]• Luo Li[/p][p]- Slightly reduced the Five Elements energy gained from activating the paper dove and slightly decreased the Five Elements energy gained from sealing the array eye.[/p][p]- Slightly increased the cooldown time of the right-click dash of the main star skill.[/p][p]• Yun Jian[/p][p]- Now, when a vengeful spirit approaches the stone slab, it will trigger the destruction countdown, and when the stone slab is attacked, the countdown will be reduced by 5 seconds. [/p][p][/p][p]<Secondary Star>[/p][p]• Left Assistant (Fire)[/p][p]- New addition: Enters a very short cooldown period after triggering the effect. [/p][p][/p][p]<Revenants>[/p][p]• Lei Zhenzi[/p][p]- Now, when removing the Thunder Cone, the Spirit Detective in stealth mode cannot interact to remove it.[/p][p]• Bai Wuchang[/p][p]- Now, when removing the Soul Summoning Flag, the Spirit Detective in stealth mode cannot interact to remove it.[/p][p]• Xiao Jiang[/p][p]- New: During the flight period of Skill 3, the player can press the spacebar to increase the flight height and press the shift key to decrease the flight height.[/p][p]• Spatula Maniac[/p][p]- New: Added an attack counter. Causing three hits will grant one layer of oil.[/p][p]• Dracula[/p][p]- Modified Skill 3, Bat Teleportation, to right-click for teleportation.[/p][p]- Slightly increased the maximum health of the bats.[/p][p]- Slightly increased the teleportation range and the range is further increased when in bat form.[/p][p]• Sword Spirit[/p][p]- Slightly reduced the additional true damage of Skill 3.[/p][p]• Jinhe[/p][p]- Slightly reduced the additional damage per stack of Fire Poison. [/p][p][/p][p]<Deception>[/p][p]• Wraith[/p][p]- Significantly increased cooldown[/p][p]- Slightly reduced duration[/p][p]• Corpse Poison[/p][p]- Significantly increased cooldown [/p][p][/p][p]1. Now, when a Spirit Detective is disconnected, they will no longer provide Soul or Skill Points to the Ghosts when attacked.[/p][p]2. When a Spirit Detective holds down the middle mouse button to move the view, they will not be able to run.[/p][p]3. The portal has been modified to be interacted with by pressing E to teleport.[/p][p]4. The duration verification for completing a Master-Apprentice match has been changed from 7 minutes to 5 minutes.[/p][p]5. A prompt will now appear in the team formation interface when attempting to draw a treasure box if it cannot be drawn.[/p][p]6. Detailed information about the gift pack will now be displayed in the floating box when purchasing a gift pack in the store.[/p][p]7. The current Intimacy level and experience will now be displayed in the profile.[/p][p]8. Skill information of the character can now be seen in the BP interface.[/p][p]9. A fall animation will now be shown when a Spirit Detective is knocked down.[/p][p]New Feature: "Map Ban Selection": In the ranked mode BP stage, 2 maps can now be banned (one by the Spirit Detective side and one by the Simulated Ghost side). [/p][p][/p][p]Season S13: Neon City[/p][p]Event Time: After version update - October 31, 2025[/p][p]\[New Season Introduction][/p][p]1. A brand new season has begun. Rank and power will be recalculated from Season S13.[/p][p]\[New Rank Rewards][/p][p]1. Spirit Detective Rank Reward: Blue Heron - Neon Campus, Nan Gong Yichen - I Don't Like Scallions (Back Decoration), Neon Spirit Detective (Title)[/p][p]2. Wraith Rank Reward: Nie Xiaoqian - Neon Night Shadow, Xue Nu - Where's My Radish (Weapon), Neon Cursed Shadow (Title)[/p][p]\[New Season Pass: Neon City][/p][p]Participate in various gameplay to obtain \[Soul Jade], upgrade the Season Pass level, and unlock a large number of rare items such as Spirit Stones, rare costumes, and limited avatars.[/p][p]The final week of the season will be a sprint! The first dynamic emoticon, "Big Boss~ So Cool! (Little Spider)", is now available in the Zhenzhen Mall for just 358 Zhenzhen Coins!! tags.balance_change: - Slightly increased the armor value Jia Hui has in the Seven Kill state.
- Slightly reduced the stamina cost of using the main star skill.
- Optimized the size of the interaction box, making it easier to interact with the main star skill's flying sword.
- During the burrowing period, she is considered to be in a crouching state.
- Slightly reduced the Five Elements energy gained from activating the paper dove and slightly decreased the Five Elements energy gained from sealing the array eye.
- Slightly increased the cooldown time of the right-click dash of the main star skill.
- Now, when a vengeful spirit approaches the stone slab, it will trigger the destruction countdown, and when the stone slab is attacked, the countdown will be reduced by 5 seconds.

tags.feature: - New addition: Enters a very short cooldown period after triggering the effect.

tags.balance_change: - Now, when removing the Thunder Cone, the Spirit Detective in stealth mode cannot interact to remove it.
- Now, when removing the Soul Summoning Flag, the Spirit Detective in stealth mode cannot interact to remove it.

tags.feature: - New: During the flight period of Skill 3, the player can press the spacebar to increase the flight height and press the shift key to decrease the flight height.
- New: Added an attack counter. Causing three hits will grant one layer of oil.

tags.balance_change: - Modified Skill 3, Bat Teleportation, to right-click for teleportation.
- Slightly increased the maximum health of the bats.
- Slightly increased the teleportation range and the range is further increased when in bat form.
- Slightly reduced the additional true damage of Skill 3.
- Slightly reduced the additional damage per stack of Fire Poison.
- Significantly increased cooldown
- Slightly reduced duration
- Significantly increased cooldown
1. Now, when a Spirit Detective is disconnected, they will no longer provide Soul or Skill Points to the Ghosts when attacked.
2. When a Spirit Detective holds down the middle mouse button to move the view, they will not be able to run.
3. The portal has been modified to be interacted with by pressing E to teleport.
4. The duration verification for completing a Master-Apprentice match has been changed from 7 minutes to 5 minutes.

tags.feature: 5. A prompt will now appear in the team formation interface when attempting to draw a treasure box if it cannot be drawn.
6. Detailed information about the gift pack will now be displayed in the floating box when purchasing a gift pack in the store.
7. The current Intimacy level and experience will now be displayed in the profile.
8. Skill information of the character can now be seen in the BP interface.
9. A fall animation will now be shown when a Spirit Detective is knocked down.
New Feature: "Map Ban Selection": In the ranked mode BP stage, 2 maps can now be banned (one by the Spirit Detective side and one by the Simulated Ghost side).

tags.balance_change: - Slightly increased maximum stamina.

- Some of Bai Qiulian's skills can generate pools of water on the ground (the duration and effect are the same as the 3rd skill, and both the effect and duration increase with the level of the 3rd skill).
- The water balls of Bai Qiulian can continuously generate a pool of water on the ground along their flight path.
- When Bai Qiulian releases her 1st skill, a pool of water can be generated at the position of the water bubble.
- When Bai Qiulian releases her 2nd skill, pools of water are generated along the path of the water bubble's movement.

- When Bai Qiulian releases her area-of-effect skill, if there are pools of water within the initial range of the area, all the pools within the range will be consumed, and each consumed pool can increase the size of the area.
- The duration of the pools generated by Bai Qiulian's 3rd skill has been reduced.
- The slow effect of the pools generated by Bai Qiulian's 3rd skill has been reduced.
- The maximum distance that Bai Qiulian's water balls can travel after being launched has been reduced.

tags.bug: 1. Fixed the issue where Human Jiang Muwan's primary star skill could not pass the paper in most walls on the pyramid map.

2. Fixed the problem where Human Wu QiZhi's primary star skill would immediately enter cooldown when interrupted by switching items or jumping over obstacles before entering stealth mode during the pre-cast animation.
3. Fixed the issue where Human Su Qingli's primary star skill would immediately enter cooldown when interrupted during the animation.

4. Fixed the problem where Human Ao Feng and Human Na Lan Lian Wu would consume all 4 layers of the trap from Simulated Ghost Nine-Tailed Fox's 2nd skill at once when the primary star skill was reflected.
5. Fixed the issue where Human Luo Li could gain energy by pressing G to discard the pigeon and left-click to release it simultaneously.
6. Fixed the problem where Humans would be unable to interact for the entire game if knocked down by a Ghost during the period of opening the third eye.
7. Fixed the issue where Simulated Ghost Ba Chi Da Ren would keep accelerating until the next trigger of the chase when the Human wearing the hat left his vision while in stealth mode.
8. Fixed the problem where Human would have a hit animation when the damage from Simulated Ghost Huang Xian's 2nd skill was reflected by the substitute life red envelope.
9. Fixed the issue where Simulated Ghost Xiao Li's full-level domain skill placed within the array eye range would not slow down the Human.
10. Fixed the problem where the stun from the exclusive trick "Fierce Spirit Doll" of Simulated Ghost Yao Ou was lost when the 2nd skill was triggered.
11. Fixed the issue where Human could not pass through obstacles (Little Red Channel) during the remaining time of Simulated Ghost Xiao Pi's 2nd skill when using the 3rd skill.

notes.title: "Soul Dossier" August 8th Update Announcement
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]"Soul Dossier" August 8th Update Announcement 

Dear Agent,

The "Soul Dossier" server will undergo maintenance at 10:00 on August 8th (UTC+8). The maintenance is expected to last for 180 minutes. During this period, all agents will be unable to log in to the game. Please arrange your time accordingly to avoid any unnecessary losses. The server's reopening time may be earlier or later depending on the actual situation. We appreciate your understanding and support. 

▶ Maintenance Compensation ◀
10,000 Spirit Coins, 500 Ancient Coins, 1 Lucky Treasure Chest, 1 Forget Worry Wine, 3 Double Spirit Coin Cards
Please claim them via in-game mail, and remember to check within the specified time! 

【Balance Adjustment】
<Human>
• Wei Qingyu
- Slightly enhanced the control effect of the primary star skill's left-click. 

• Little Bing
- Slightly reduced the cooldown time required for each layer of energy. 

• Li Xiaotu
- Slightly reduced the detection range for triggering heartbeats.
- New addition: During the shrinking period, the position of the Ghost's body within the heartbeat range can be seen through (cannot see through in the ghost fog state), and the shrinking period is regarded as a crouching state. 

<Ghost>
• Black Wielder of the Oubliette
- Slightly increased the range of the domain skill.
- Slightly increased the movement speed of Black Wielder of the Oubliette within the domain range. 

• Huang Xian
- Slightly reduced the movement speed bonus during the connection state in Skill 3 and Domain Skill.
- Adjustment: The demonic aura mark left on the Human after Skill 2 hits now lasts only 30 seconds.
- Adjustment: The maximum duration of the red envelope received by the Human is now 300 seconds. 

Exclusive Rotation of the "Chosen Treasure Box"
Event Time: 2025/8/8 - 2025/8/22
• Exclusive skin for this period's Chosen Treasure Box: "Blue Heron - Silver Ripple Dream" is waiting for you to obtain!
• Skins available for exchange in this period's Chosen Treasure Box: "Blue Heron - Silver Ripple Dream", "Summer Rain - Quack Quack Frog", "Snow White - Winter Snow Gift", "Luo Li - Rabbit Spirit 彡彡·Misty Blue"， "Wei Qingyu - Rabbit Spirit 彡彡·Illusory Purple"， "Little Spider - Rabbit Spirit 彡彡·Peach Blossom Cherry" 
New Arrival at Star Diamond Mall

Event Period: August 8, 2025 - September 5, 2025

1. During the event period, you can exchange "Xiao Bing - Miao Miao" at the Star Diamond Mall. 

Theme Treasure Box: Rabbit Spirit 彡彡
"Rabbit Spirit Pact, Bind Three Souls."
Event Time: After version update - September 5, 2025
1. The Rabbit Spirit 彡彡 series of costumes can be obtained by drawing in the Rabbit Spirit 彡彡 theme/selected treasure box.
2. During the event period， collect the full set of costumes for a single character to exchange for exclusive items for free. 

"Star Diamond Reappearance"
Event Time: 2025/8/8 - 2025/8/22
During the event period, "Ouyang Miaomiao - Bunny Trainer" and "He Ruoyao - Peachy Enchantment" will be available for limited-time purchase in the Star Diamond Mall, where you can exchange for the corresponding outfits and weapons.
During the event period, "Ouyang Miaomiao - Bunny Trainer", "He Ruoyao - Peachy Enchantment", "Shen Wanyin - Crimson Star River", and "Nie Xiaoqian - Flower Shadow Illusion Star · Purple Garden" actions will be available for limited-time purchase in the Star Diamond Mall, where you can exchange for the corresponding actions. 

"Treasure Hunt Returns for a Limited Time"
\[Treasure Pavilion]
Event Rules:
1. During the event period, you can use "Treasure Keys" to open the Treasure Pavilion and draw skins.
2. The "Treasure Pavilion" treasure hunt event is limited to 72 hours per round. After the event ends, the rewards in the pool will automatically rotate, and the draw count will be reset. There may be server time differences during the rotation, so please avoid treasure hunting during the rotation process.
3. The Treasure Pavilion has nine floors, and each floor has an "Ultimate Reward". Only after drawing the current floor's "Ultimate Reward" can you unlock the next floor's "Ultimate Reward" draw. Once you reach the top floor and obtain the "Ultimate Reward", you cannot continue treasure hunting (for this round).
4. The first floor of the Treasure Pavilion can only be drawn once, while from the second floor onwards, you can perform a ten-draw. The ten-draw only draws from the current floor's pool and there is a chance to obtain multiple "Ultimate Rewards" from the same floor in one draw.
5. On the ninth floor, you only need one draw to obtain the "Ultimate Reward".
6. After the version update, the Treasure Pavilion rewards will automatically transition to the next round after the settlement is completed.
7. Ways to obtain "Treasure Keys":
- "Treasure Pavilion Check-in" event check-in
- "Secret Realm Key" event page exchange/purchase limited packages
- "Key Replenishment Plan"
"Use more keys to earn more! The more you use, the more you get, and it's super cost-effective."
Every use is a surprise unlock, and the more you accumulate, the richer the rewards.
8. Preview of the Treasure Pavilion reward rounds (for details, please refer to the in-game event introduction)
\[A Round]: "Su Qingli - Sisi Hongyun" "Blue Heron - Ziluahuaqiu"
\[B Round]: "Blue Heron - Rumen Yuyin · Indigo" "Ling Zhengying - Subject Three" "Nalan Liandu - Tuji Guagua"
\[C Round]: "Lin Muhuan - Sisi Ruyi" "Qin Qiang - Only Because of the Lover"
\[D Round]: "Wei Qingyu - Xiangshi Jin · Xingshu" "He Ruoyao - Zanlan Huaqiu" 

"New Arrivals at the Trading Pavilion"
"Blue Heron - Auspicious Clouds · Rain Following the Pavilion & Night Heron Branch - Auspicious Clouds · Snow Surrounding the Sky & Ouyang Miaomiao - Auspicious Clouds · Spring Light Embroidery" Series 

1. Fixed the issue where some Human characters like Tang Mo and Man Lin did not consume the durability of the Night Vision Goggles when using the Primary Star skill during the skill's duration.
2. Fixed the issue where Human character Nan Lan Lian Wu could perform a super jump by pressing the E key to pick up the Night Vision Goggles and the R key to use the Primary Star skill simultaneously.

Ink Dou
Being able to generate a line of ink between two adjacent walls, any vengeful spirit that touches the line will be repelled. After selecting the item, clicking the left mouse button will automatically restore 10/15/20 soul points. When pointing the mouse at teammates within a certain distance, you can right-click to reply to teammates with 10/15/20 soul points.
Tai Chi Bagua Mirror

"The Lucky Treasure Box has been upgraded with a huge selection of over a thousand outfits for you to draw!
The player-designed outfit 'Li Xiaotu - Nuan Nuan Mi Guan' is now available in the Lucky Gift Box~"

Event Time: After version update - April 29, 23:59:59
The top of the Star Diamond Ranking can win a Star Diamond Luminous Treasure Box! The top of the Good Luck Ranking can win a Theme Rare Treasure Box!
1. Participate in the corresponding ranking by drawing the corresponding treasure box.

2. Fixed the problem where Simulated Ghost Yang Qilang's 1st skill could pass through walls at certain points in the office map.
3. Fixed the issue where Simulated Ghost Jin He's 3rd skill could not interrupt the main star skill of the Blue Heron when hitting it.
4. Fixed the problem where the lower part of the staircase in School A's teacher's office would forcibly pull the player outside the map when hit by the 3rd skill of the Small Spider.
5. Fixed the issue where Xiao Pi, while being pushed back by Ling Zhengying's main star during the pushback process (not after the pushback ends), could use the 1st skill to transform into a human and chase the Spirit Hunter. If the player pressed 'Z' to transform back into Xiao Pi, they would be forcibly pulled back to the coordinates where they transformed into a human, and would be blocked by walls, floors, ceilings, or other obstacles.
6. Fixed the issue where Xiao Bing's door not being generated would cause a sound effect when Xiao Pi hit the door and a combo point when the Sword Spirit hit it.
7. Fixed the problem where the Spirit Hunter often could not see the binding trap released by Simulated Ghost Bai Wuchang in the Pyramid map even when using the Night Vision Goggles.
8. Fixed the issue where Bai Xue - Fairy Spirit Snow Reflection (Hair) had abnormal hair color display in the hall.
9. Attempted to fix the issue where Simulated Ghost Spatula Man's model displayed abnormally after entering the game.
10. Fixed the problem where the Wraith Couple in the training ground could not use their 1st skill and Dracula could not use his 2nd skill.
11. Fixed the issue where the small zombies released by Simulated Ghost Jin He's 2nd skill would get stuck at certain points in the office map and the Pyramid map.
12. Fixed the problem where the pit in the Pyramid map could not be climbed.
13. Fixed the issues of abnormal wraith chase points, abnormal reduction of soul and health points for the Spirit Hunter when hit by wraiths, and abnormal damage caused by some wraiths to the Spirit Hunter.
14. Fixed the issue where there was no location in the Fishing Village.
15. Fixed the problem where the bean soldiers summoned by Ouyang Miaomiao's main star skill could be knocked down by the Spirit Hunter.
16. Fixed the issue where Jia Hui - Spring Outing (Set) and Ling Zhengying - Laser Sword · Pink Fantasy could not be tried on in the mall fitting room.

《Soul Dossier》March 28th Update Announcement

Dear Agents,  

The **Soul Dossier** server will undergo maintenance starting at **March 28th, 11:30 (UTC+8)** and is expected to last approximately **180 minutes**. During this period, all agents will be unable to log in to the game. Please plan your gameplay accordingly to avoid unnecessary losses. The reopening time may be adjusted based on actual progress—thank you for your understanding and support!

**【Feature Adjustments】**  
1. **Map - Fishing Village Reset** Now Available in Matchmaking Mode

**『Event 1 - Anniversary Daily Activity』**

Complete anniversary tasks to earn **Ling Zhengying - Sisi Nianhua**, Good Fortune Chest x10, Premium Chest x5, and other rewards!  
- **Daily Basic Tasks**: Earn 170 activity points (full rewards in 9 days).  
- **Daily Basic + Advanced Tasks**: Earn 230 activity points (full rewards in 7 days).  

**『Event 2 - Exquisite Chest & Supreme Store』**  
*"Fortune favors the bold—unlock the treasures within!"*  
- New **Exquisite Chest** and **Limited Anniversary Bundles** available for 2 weeks.  
- Purchase bundles to obtain Spirit Stones, Exquisite Chests, Item Chests, Trick Chests, Premium Chests, Spirit Coins, and more!  
- **Time**: 2025/3/28 – 2025/4/11  
- **Rules**:  
  • Exquisite Chests and bundles are time-limited.  
  • Draw Exquisite Chests to earn **Supreme Coins** for兑换 exclusive skins.  
  • **Daily Limit**: 12¥, 30¥, 68¥, and 128¥ bundles (1 purchase/day).  
  • **Weekly Limit**: 328¥ and 648¥ bundles (1 purchase/week).  
  • **Featured Skin**: **Wei Qingyu - Cocoa Bunny** (increased drop rate—don’t miss it!).  
  • **Supreme Store Skins**: Xiao Hu - Drowning Dust纱·Golden Stream, Ouyang Miaomiao - Rosy Overture, Shen Wanyin - Butterfly’s Heart, Wu Qizhi - Golden Snake Tower, Yun Jian - Golden Scaled Tower.  

**『Event 3 - Star Diamond Store Anniversary Revival』**  
*"Sparkling crystals, a throne of radiance—relive past glories!"*  
- **Time**: During Anniversary Celebrations  
- **Rules**:

notes.title: Soul Dossier Version Plan
notes.content:
Firstly, we would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the investigators for your continuous support of "Soul Dossier" (bow)! Through various channels such as player groups, feedback forms, and YY, we have received a vast number of suggestions from players (over a thousand). Although we cannot reply to each one individually, we have carefully read and recorded every piece of feedback. Regarding the issues you care about, we always adhere to the principle of "listening to advice" and are committed to implementing your feedback into future version optimizations.

This version plan will be divided into three sections. The first part addresses the frequently asked questions, the second part outlines the functional optimization plans, and the third part reveals the update plans for new characters in future versions!


[h3]I. Soul Dossier Q&A[/h3]
Q: When will the Fishing Village return? I'm tired of playing the same few maps over and over.
A: The Fishing Village map has often been criticized for its unclear layers, issues with fighting between floors, and character models getting stuck in map seams. We plan to completely revamp the Fishing Village map and will reopen it to players once the revamp is complete. The exact release date is not yet determined, but we will announce the latest news on social media as soon as possible. Stay tuned!

Q: Please implement ranking level restrictions! New players keep getting knocked down as soon as they enter ranked matches. How are they supposed to play?
A: Ranking level restrictions were updated and launched on February 14th. Currently, players below level 51 are restricted from entering ranked matches. New players can improve their skills through match-made games. We will continue to optimize the level restriction criteria based on your feedback.

Q: Can past Star Diamond skins be re-released? The Star Diamond skins never change.
A: We will revamp the Star Diamond Treasure Box in the future, reintroducing most past Star Diamond skins for players to draw. The drop rate of Star Diamond skins will be increased, but the output of Star Diamonds will be reduced (48% -> 38.4%). Don't worry if you draw duplicate Star Diamond skins; they can be dismantled into Star Diamonds! Past Heaven's Choice skins will also be added to the Star Diamond Treasure Box, and experience cards will be removed. These changes are expected to be implemented in the February version update.

Q: The output from the Good Fortune Treasure Box has decreased. Can we get some high-quality skins in there?
A: After the changes to the Good Fortune Treasure Box, we have been closely monitoring player feedback. To enhance the appeal of the Good Fortune Treasure Box, in the February version update, we will add some Heaven's Choice, Manual, active, and direct-sale type costumes to the Good Fortune Treasure Box. These rewards will be permanent and available for players to draw. They will also be available through other channels.

Q: When will the seasonal skins be updated to the seasonal treasure box? There was no way to get last season's skins.
A: After the current "Floating Life Season" ends, we plan to include all past seasonal skins (including Supreme skins) in the seasonal treasure box and remove the seasonal Supreme treasure box. Please stay tuned to the update announcements for specific adjustment times.

Q: The mentor-apprentice system is just a formality. I've taken my apprentice from level 1 to 50, and the mentor-apprentice coins aren't even enough to exchange for a costume.
A: The level at which apprentices graduate is indeed too easily achieved. In the February update, we will adjust the apprentice graduation level to 80 and add new costumes to the mentor-apprentice store as incentives.

Q: Give us back the ability to exchange hair colors for complete sets! Costumes without hair are soulless!
A: We are gradually reintroducing the exchange of hair colors for complete sets to the treasure scroll page. Since we need to adapt to the treasure scroll page, the previous exchange pages need to be remade, so they cannot all be reintroduced at once. However, we have a plan to add several exchange pages every week in the updates.

Q: There are too many ineffective tricks and props; they just take up backpack space.
A: In the future, we will open the decomposition of tricks, props, and auxiliary stars. You can decompose unused props into currency.

Q: Opening the Ancient Coin Treasure Box is too expensive. The skins inside are rarely updated, and there are no ways to get ancient coins.
A: We will include ancient coins as compensation in daily updates and maintenance. We plan to lower the price of opening the Ancient Coin Treasure Box and add new costumes in the March version update. (Note: Soul Dossier live broadcast events give away a large number of ancient coins!)

---
[h3]II. Functional Optimization Directions[/h3]
1. Optimization of Match/Ranked Treasure Boxes is on the way!
Since their launch, match/ranked treasure boxes have been the most frequently obtained by players. However, the limited variety and low quality of costumes in the boxes have not been very attractive to players. In future versions, we will add additional golden quality costumes to the match/ranked treasure boxes to encourage players to obtain them. We will also restrict low-settlement-score players from obtaining match/ranked treasure boxes.

2. Optimization of Special Investigator Rewards
We plan to optimize the reward system for Special Investigators. On top of the existing benefits, we will introduce a daily check-in feature. After activating Special Investigator status, players can claim one Good Fortune Treasure Box daily. This feature is currently under development and testing.
3. Newbie Pool is Under Testing and Development!

It's not uncommon for new players to be overwhelmed when matched with experienced players, leading to a poor gaming experience. This is one of the key feedback points, as it affects the growth of new players in Soul Dossier. We plan to introduce a newbie pool in the match mode, targeting players below level 51. Players level 51 and above will not be able to enter the newbie pool, and newbie pool players can only be matched with others in the same pool. We hope this will improve the early-game experience for new players and help them get up to speed quickly. (Note: Experienced players cannot enter the newbie pool even when matching with new players.) We will continue to optimize based on player surveys, so please keep an eye on future in-game surveys!

4. Too Many Dances to Choose From? Dance Wheel to the Rescue!
As of now, the game features nearly 300 dance actions, with almost every character equipped with more than three dance actions. However, players can only select one dance to use during matches. To allow players to switch dances more freely during matches, we are developing a dance wheel feature. Players will be able to bring multiple dances into matches and use them, engaging in "dance-offs" with other players!

5. Finding a Team is Too Hard? Queue Channel on the Way!
We have always been aware of the difficulties players face when forming teams. It can be challenging for solo players to find a team. To provide a smoother teaming experience, we will add a Queue List to the world list. All team invites posted in the world chat will be displayed here. This feature is still under development and testing by the studio team.

6. Decomposition Password Function Restart!
When decomposing items, players sometimes accidentally click and mistakenly decompose high-quality costumes or props, especially with the upcoming decomposition of some Star Diamond costumes (into Star Diamonds). To reduce the frequency of accidental decomposition, we plan to introduce a secondary password verification mechanism. When decomposing items, players will need to enter a secondary password for confirmation. Since the decomposition password function requires mechanisms for password recovery and other verifications, the development workload is significantly increased. Therefore, the studio team is still working on it!

7. Optimization of Intimacy Level Rewards
We plan to add a new reward for character intimacy levels above 100—a character title. This will showcase players' love for their characters.

8. New Moon Spirit Talisman (Monthly Card) Function Optimization
We have been closely monitoring the performance data of the New Moon Spirit Talisman (monthly card) and collecting player feedback. Our investigation revealed that the current monthly card reward collection process is cumbersome: players need to find the monthly card page, select the card type, sign in, and then collect the rewards. This process is clearly not convenient and provides a poor collection experience.
To address this, we will reshape the overall functionality of the New Moon Spirit Talisman (monthly card). The optimized adjustments are as follows:
After purchasing the monthly card, rewards will be automatically distributed upon logging into the game. There will be no need for manual sign-in or collection; rewards will be directly deposited into your account. This feature requires remaking, so we kindly ask for a little more time to fine-tune it.

9. More Practical Functionality Optimizations!
In addition to the popular features you care about, we are also advancing the detail optimizations of the game. For example, the game loading screen now includes a "Tip of the Day." Attentive players may have noticed that the bottom right corner of the match waiting interface now displays a line of text: "Tip of the Day." We have included some interesting Soul Dossier-related trivia, but the number of tips is still far from enough. Recently, we will release a survey on social


[h3]III. Character Update Plan[/h3]
▶ New Spirit Investigator - Tang Mo (Male) ◀
Tang Mo comes from a family of medical practitioners and has been immersed in the study of medicine and music theory since childhood. He is proficient in medical skills and excels in playing musical instruments. As a Spirit Investigator who specializes in control and support, he uses the guzheng (a traditional Chinese zither) as his instrument. By playing different musical scores, he can trigger various effects: enhancing his teammates' mobility and survivability while weakening the threats posed by grudge spirits. He can create a safe environment for the team and control the pace of the match, making him an indispensable core member of the team.
Difficulty Level: ★★★★

New Spirit Investigator - Tang Mo is expected to debut in Season 10! Stay tuned to our official account "Soul Dossier" for more leaks about the new season.

▶ New Grudge Spirit - Yehuo Nüba ◀
Nüba first appeared in the "Book of Songs" as the daughter of the Yellow Emperor. In the "Classic of Mountains and Seas," she is considered the progenitor of zombies. Drought spirits are believed to have clashed with other deities on high mountains, causing droughts and famines. Her body contains the power of a fallen sun, and she possesses an even more intense Yehuo (karmic fire) power.
Difficulty Level: ★★★

Investigators, to better optimize the game, we hope to receive more feedback from you! Surveys are the most effective way for us to understand your needs. We hope you can take the time to provide your valuable input.
Thank you to every investigator for your support and companionship. The journey is long, but may Soul Dossier continue to accompany you along the way!

notes.title: Soul Dossier Update Announcement for February 21st
notes.content:
Dear Investigators,
The Soul Dossier servers will undergo maintenance at 16:10 on February 21st (UTC+8), with an expected downtime of 180 minutes. During this period, all investigators will be unable to log in to the game. Please arrange your time accordingly to avoid any unnecessary losses! The server reopening time may be advanced or delayed based on the actual situation. Thank you for your understanding and support.

▶ Maintenance Compensation ◀
Spirit Coins x10,000
Ancient Coins x500
Good Fortune Treasure Box x1
Carefree Wine x1
Double Spirit Coins Card x3
Please claim your compensation through in-game mail and note the deadline for claiming.

▶ Details of This Update ◀
Functional Adjustments
Removed some tricks from the store.
S9 season-end sprint! The soul jade cap for the pass has been increased, and soul jade acquisition has been significantly improved!
Added high-quality costumes such as Star Diamond Red, Heaven's Choice, and Manual in the Star Diamond Treasure Box, and removed experience cards.
Star Diamond Red costume drop rate adjusted: 0.003% -> 0.4%
Golden quality costume drop rate adjusted: 4.9997% -> 8.75%
Star Diamond drop rate adjusted: 48% -> 38.4%
Some Star Diamond Red costumes can now be dismantled into Star Diamonds, with the dismantling amount calculated based on a certain proportion of the original price of the Star Diamonds.
Added Heaven's Choice, Manual, and Monthly Active quality costumes to the Good Fortune Treasure Box.
Match/Ranked Treasure Box adjustments:
Spirit Investigators below 2000 settlement points will not receive treasure boxes.
Grudge Spirits below 3000 settlement points will not receive treasure boxes.
Seasonal Treasure Box adjustments:
Seasonal treasure boxes can now draw skins from previous seasons.
The Seasonal Supreme Treasure Box will be removed after this season ends.
The apprentice level in the mentor-apprentice system has been increased to level 80.
The refresh time for the New Moon Spirit Talisman is now daily at 00:00.
The in-match announcement function has been optimized to now display the number of fragments still needed to seal the array eye.
The version plan has been updated, and you can view the 2025 Soul Dossier version plan in the settings:
Quick jump → Version Plan
『Star Diamond Mall: Flowing Light』
The Star Diamond Treasure Box has added a large number of skins, with continuous draws of Heaven's Choice and Star Diamond costumes!
The drop rate of Star Diamond Red in the Star Diamond Treasure Box has been increased by a hundred times! The drop rate of golden quality skins has doubled!
The limited-time Star Diamond costume, Xiang Nuannuan - Flowing Light Fairy, can be exchanged in the Star Diamond Mall, and collecting it allows you to exchange for the exclusive hair color of Flowing Light Fairy.
Wearing the full set activates new skill effects and exclusive idle actions.

『Good Fortune Gift』
The Good Fortune Treasure Box has been significantly upgraded, with over a thousand costumes to choose from!
The first player-designed costume, "Su Qingli - Super Cute Soft Bear," is now available in the Good Fortune Gift.
『Fortune Tickets』
Event Time: Starting after the version update - March 7, 2025
After the event ends, all fortune tickets in the backpack will be cleared.
Bug Fixes
Fixed the issue where Yang Qilang could quickly move by sprinting and upgrading skills.
Fixed the issue where rewards in the monthly active event would be directly used upon collection.
Fixed the issue where the trick "Flower Array" would not take effect.
Fixed the issue with microphone abnormalities.
Fixed the issue where Wei Qingyu could quickly move by jumping during the main star sprint.
Now, falling into the elevator interior will teleport you to the elevator entrance.

Soul Dossier Showdown

After Spirit Investigators are chosen, players will randomly receive a Grudge Spirit role.
Killing and capturing points can earn corresponding transformation points. a. Kill +1 point b. Successfully capturing a point +1 point, and team members occupying the point will gain an additional point.
When transformation points reach 5, press the N key to transform into a Grudge Spirit for 60 seconds. Grudge Spirits can freely use all skills without consuming soul power and have a certain amount of soul power that can be destroyed.
Grudge Spirits cannot attack each other; friendly Grudge Spirits will only deal damage to enemy Spirit Investigators. Killing Spirit Investigators and Grudge Spirits in Grudge Spirit form does not provide transformation points.

notes.title: 7/26 Soul Dossier Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear detective,
The Lingjing system is expected to undergo a version update on 7/26 10:00 (UTC/GMT:+8:00), which is expected to take 180 minutes. This update will restart the server, and online agents will be forced to log off. Please log off early to avoid losses! We will notify you separately after the server is opened. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the simulation training of the agents! This update will distribute compensation: spirit coins x 10000, good luck treasure box x 1, forget your worries wine x 1, double spirit coin card x 3.


【 Welfare function added 】
Weekly Exemption Role
Detective Camp: Wu Qizhi, Nangong Yichen, Xia Shiyu, Yan Chixia, Ling Zhengying, Ge Yongming
Simulated vengeful faction: Bai Qiulian, Yang Qilang, Black Impermanence, Spoon Madness Demon
Extra weekly exemption for 'Special Agent'
Detective Camp: Qinghong, Xiaoxue, Wei Qingyu, Sikongxing, Manlin, Nalanlianwu, Ning Caichen, He Ruoyao, Su Qingli
Simulate the vengeful spirit faction: Dracula, Lei Zhenzi, Xiao Spider, Resentful Couple, Nine Tailed Fox

[New Activity]
Star Diamond Mall - Crystal
This is the choice of agate stone
Event time: July 26-2024/8/23, 2024
Activity Description:
During the event, you can draw diamonds from the Star Diamond Chest or exchange them for "Xiang Nuannuan - Agate Queen" on the Star Diamond Mall
The clothing comes with special effects, and wearing the full set can activate new skill effects
Wearing clothing can activate new skill effects and exclusive standby actions
The Star Diamond Mall theme is available for a limited time of one month
Treasure Hunt in Treasure Pavilion
Exploring hidden treasures, adventures in the pavilion
After the version update, a new reward round for the Treasure Pavilion has been added, and the next round will only be entered after the previous round of settlement.
【 Round 1 】: "Qin Qiang - New Start Series" "Summer Rain - Ice Blade Fantasy Butterfly Series"
【 Round 2 】: "Xiao Ming - Pet Backpack (Back)" "Peng Gang - Qingteng (Back)" "Sword Spirit Bgm" "Proud Wind - Martial Arts Dragon Flame Series" "Yan Chixia - Shaking Flower Hand (Action)" "Ling Zhengying - Breaking Water Spirit (Back)"
【 Round 3 】 "Ge Yongming - Mutant Green Fish Head (Head)" "Black Impermanence - Dark Night Envoy · Falling Bright Series" "Luo Fang - Thin Silk Sulan Series"
The 'Star Diamond Supreme Treasure Box' is now available for a limited time!
-Super popular character skills, special effects, red quality skin, limited time return!!
-The limited time return of the Star Diamond Supreme Treasure Box in this issue features red quality skins for "Wei Qingyu - Foolish Heart Witch Series" and "He Ruoyao - Cold and Beautiful Rose Series"
-This treasure box can draw gold quality skins including: Su Qingli Peach Blossom Snow series, Wu Qizhi Red Window Shadow series, Qing Hong Black Rose Ode series, Luo Fang Bai Qiang Praise series, and other skins
-Only red quality skins that can be retrieved from this treasure chest will not produce Star Diamond Coins

[New Features]
1. Add the function of quick decomposition experience card
2. When matching now, the current queue will be displayed

Ranking adjustment
Due to the fact that there are only 5 element fragments in a single round during the scattered ranking match, there may still be instances of element fragments getting stuck. Therefore, the flash limit for scattered ranking has been lifted.


Balance Adjustment
•<Props>
Open the Eye of Heaven (Prop)
-Added the range of simulated vengeful spirits that can be seen as invisible and the duration of props after use
Flash Bullet (Prop)
-There is no need to hit the front of the vengeful spirit now. If it is within the explosion range, the effect will be triggered
-Increased explosion range
Shield Armor Talisman (Prop)
-After successful release, you can right-click to cancel, and the armor shield will remain for 3 seconds

•<Mysterious Techniques>
Soul Formation (Mysterious Art)
-The vengeful spirit can attack the formation eye. If the attacked formation eye is sealed by the spirit probe within 120 seconds, it cannot restore its soul value
Yin Eye (Mysterious Technique)
-After sealing the formation eye once, the spirit probe will be penetrated for 20 seconds, and the water attribute will begin to devour souls
Added 'Eating Exhaust Gas (Trick)'
-Leave a poisonous mist and smoke screen on the moving path, and players within the range will stack 1 layer of epidemic poison effect per second
Add 'Egg Crush on the Ground (Trick)'
-After the explosion, a pool of toxic stains will remain, and the spirit probes within the toxic stain range will stack one layer of epidemic virus buff every second, reducing their movement speed by 20%

•<Auxiliary star class>
En Guang (Auxiliary Star)
-Increased perspective time

•<Simulation of vengeful spirits>
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Lei Zhenzi'
-Reduced the height of the lightning pillar
-Reduced the time consumed by the spirit detector in dismantling the thunder cone
-Reduced the time interval for thundercloud dissipation
-Increased the duration of domain skills
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Little Skin'
-Increased damage to domain skills
-Added duration of 2 skills
-Reduced the duration of skills that increase after hitting a spirit scout at full level by 2
• Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Xiao Wu'
-Increased damage from regular attacks
-Increased the upper limit for releasing small stiffness and the movement speed of small stiffness when using skill 2
-Reduced cooldown time for 3 skills
-Increased the number of domain skills to defeat zombies and shortened the drop interval
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Spoon Maniac'
-Expanded the scope and damage of 'Spoon Rhapsody (R skill)'
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'White Impermanence'
-Increased damage from regular attacks
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Sword Spirit'
-Now 'Sword Spirit' cannot transform into Ghost Mist during the 'Sword Skill (1 Skill)' period
-Added cooldown time for 'Cloud Piercing/Sky Breaking (2 skills)'
-Reduced the duration of skills in the 'Sword Seeking (R Skill)' field
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'vengeful spouse'
During the normal attack period of 'Resentment', it is not possible to use '123 Wooden Man (1 Skill)' to exchange positions
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Xing Tian'
-Increased cooldown time for 'God of War Charge (1 skill)'
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'Dracula'
During the normal attack period of Dracula, (R skill) cannot be used
Simulate the vengeful spirit 'little spider'
Now, after using the 'Weaving Web (1 Skill)', it will enter a 0.5 second spell cooldown

•<Spirit Exploration Category>
Lingtan "Jiahui"
-Reduced armor value after transforming using R skill
-Increased the duration of transformation using R skill
-Increased attack distance after transforming with R skill
-Reduced Jiahui's soul value
Lingtan "Sikong Star"
Significantly increased the flying speed of spells after using the main star skill
Lingtan "Ouyang Miaomiao"
Slightly reduce the movement speed of Bean Soldiers after using the R skill
Lingtan "Ruyi"
-Significantly reduced the cooldown time of the main star skill
-Increased the duration of the main star skill
Lingtan "Luo Fang"
-Reduced the cooldown time of the main star skill

[Problem fix]
1. Fixed the issue of not being able to adjust the color of the warm and warm pupils
2. Fix the issue of display errors under the stealth effect of Nangong Yichen Star Orbit · Pisces
3. Fixed the issue where Nalan Lotus Dance cannot use the main star after using Kaitian Eye
4. Fixed the issue of abnormal recovery values for auxiliary satellite stations

[New fitting room added]

notes.title: 7/23 Soul Dossier Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear detective,
The Lingjing system is expected to undergo a version update on 7/23 02:00 (UTC/GMT:+8:00), which is expected to take 180 minutes. This update will restart the server, and online agents will be forced to log off. Please log off early to avoid losses! We will notify you separately after the server is opened. We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the simulation training of the agents! This update will distribute compensation: spirit coins x 10000, good luck treasure box x 1, forget your worries wine x 1, double spirit coin card x 3.


Ranking adjustment
• Seal fragment adjustment
In the ranking mode, when the number of team members reaches four or five, sealing the formation eyes requires four elemental fragments
If the number of team members is less than four, three elemental fragments are required to seal the formation eyes.
In ranking mode, the refresh rule will be changed based on the number of element fragments of the sealed eye
When sealing 3 pieces: refresh every 4 minutes, for a total of 5 waves of refresh throughout the game.
When sealing 4 pieces: refresh every 5 minutes, the entire game will undergo 4 waves of refresh, and an additional 5 element fragments will be provided during the first wave of refresh.

Balance Adjustment
• 'Confusion (Deception)'
Add 2 seconds for Spirit Explorer to open the pigeon → Add 3 seconds for Spirit Explorer to open the pigeon
Greed (Trick)
Reduce the number of pigeons refreshed in this map by 40%, and the water attribute will start devouring souls → Reduce the number of pigeons refreshed in this map by 50%, and the water attribute will start devouring souls
• 'Injury (Trick)'
Every time the spirit probe falls, the current maximum stamina decreases by 12%, and the metal begins to devour souls → Every time the spirit probe falls, the current maximum stamina decreases by 15%, and the metal begins to devour souls
Flower Formation (Mysterious Art)
When the spirit probe starts sealing one of the array eyes, the other array eyes will be locked and cannot be sealed for 8 seconds → When the spirit probe starts sealing one of the array eyes, the other array eyes will be locked and cannot be sealed for 10 seconds
• "Locking Array (Trick)"
After each eye is successfully sealed twice, it will automatically lock and cannot be sealed for 90 seconds. → After each eye is successfully sealed twice, it will automatically lock and cannot be sealed for 100 seconds
• 'Broken Formation (Trick)'
After sealing the fragment into the array eye, the array eye is locked and cannot be sealed again for 30 seconds → After sealing the fragment into the array eye, the array eye is locked and cannot be sealed again for 40 seconds
• 'Virtual Body (Deception Technique)'
When sealing the array eyes, 7 health points are lost per second, and the fire attribute begins to devour souls → When sealing the array eyes, 9 health points are lost per second, and the fire attribute begins to devour souls
• 'Yin Soul (Mysterious Technique)'
40% chance of losing an additional soul every time the spirit probe falls, and the earth attribute begins to devour souls → 50% chance of losing an additional soul every time the spirit probe falls, and the earth attribute begins to devour souls

Price adjustment for the 'Mystery Treasure Box':
The single opening price has been reduced from 1000 Lingcoin to 800 Lingcoin.
The opening price of the Ten Links has dropped from 8888 Ringcoins to 7200 Ringcoins.
• Refresh fragment interval optimization:
When refreshing fragments, there will be a certain interval between adjacent element fragments.
Optimization of the position of the 'Portal':
Adjusted the position of the portal for the 'Pyramid (Map)'
Adjustment of cooling time for the 'Portal':
Lingtan: After using the 'Portal', it will enter a 10 second cooldown period during which the Portal cannot be used again.
Ghost: The cooldown period for using the 'Portal' is 1 second.

notes.content:

Dear Investigators,

Greetings! Below is a series of new features and optimization content that will be introduced in the upcoming version:

New Friend Nickname Feature:
You can add personalized nicknames for each friend, helping investigators to quickly and accurately identify and manage their friend list.

New Title System:
Participating in game activities will unlock various unique titles that showcase the personal charm of the investigators.

New Character Ranking System:
Each character will have an independent points ranking system. Investigators can improve their character's combat power by participating in matches or ranked games, and then compete for rankings and exclusive honorary titles on the ranking list.

New In-Game Mute Feature:
Investigators can mute other people's chat and voice in the game.

Resolution Adaptation Optimization:
We have fully optimized the game's resolution adaptation to enhance the gaming experience for investigators.

Werewolf Mode Character Restrictions:
In the Werewolf mode, we have made some adjustments to character selection, and the Huowang character will no longer be available for use.

Please continue to follow our official channels for the latest game update information.

Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!

Soul Dossier Bureau

Event Time: 2024/4/29 - 2024/5/17
In the Phoenix Song of the Birds event, the Xiaoli - Birds · Phoenix Song series can be obtained in the Tianxuan Treasure Box, with a non-repeat draw accumulation, and a limited-time discount to obtain. Collecting the full set will reward you with an exclusive series ghost fog.

"Happy May Day, sign in for gifts!"

"Koi Wish Pond"
"Purchase a Lucky Treasure Box, make a wish with the koi, and start a journey of good fortune!"
Event Rules

Participation Method: Participate by purchasing 1 Lucky Treasure Box for 600 Spirit Stones on the "Koi Wish Pond" event page.
Event Time: Every day from 18:00 to 24:00, one round per hour, each round lasting one hour.
Draw Time: The winning list for each round will be announced immediately after the round ends and will be publicized for 20 minutes. For example, if you participate at 18:00, the results will be announced at 18:40 and publicized until 19:00.
Draw Method: The system will randomly select 1 player to receive a beautiful costume from the prize pool, and the winning information will be displayed on the page and notified to the winner.
Prize Pool Content: Includes purple and gold quality character costumes, and will be updated from time to time with the game version update. The content will be refreshed from time to time with the game version update.
Participation Limit: Each person can purchase only 1 treasure box per round, obtaining 1 draw qualification.
"Koi Leaping Over the Dragon Gate"
"Purchase a Lucky Treasure Box, transform into a koi leaping over the dragon gate, and win rare costumes!"
Event Rules

Participation Method: Participate by purchasing 1 Lucky Treasure Box for 600 Spirit Stones on the "Koi Leaping Over the Dragon Gate" event page.
Event Time: Starting from April 29, 2024, each round starts every 8 hours and lasts for 8 hours until the event ends or the treasure boxes are sold out.
Draw Time: The winning list will be announced immediately after each round ends and will be publicized for 20 minutes. If the treasure boxes are sold out in advance, the winning list will be publicized within 20 minutes after selling out, and the next round will start immediately.
Draw Method: The system will randomly select 1 lucky player from those who purchased the treasure box to win a beautiful costume from the prize pool. The winning list will be displayed on the event page, and the winner will receive a system notification.
Prize Pool Content: Includes Tianxuan, themed, and other high-quality character costumes, which will be refreshed with the game version update.
Participation Limit: There is a limited number of Lucky Treasure Boxes available per round of the event, and the round will end once they are sold out. There is no limit to the number of treasure boxes a player can purchase, and the more you buy, the higher your chances of winning.
Example: If you purchase a treasure box at 10:00 on April 30, 2024, the winning results will be announced at 17:40 on the same day and publicized until 18:00.
Note: Only the Lucky Treasure Boxes purchased on this event page are eligible for participation.
Winning List Preservation Rule: We will keep the winning list records for the most recent ten rounds for players. This means you can inquire about the winners of the last ten draw cycles on the event page. Please note that winning data beyond ten rounds will no longer be available for inquiry.

6. Slightly increase the damage of Xiaopi Er's skill

notes.title: 3/10 灵境奇谈版本更新公告
notes.content:
3/10 灵境奇谈版本更新公告
亲爱的探员
灵镜系统预计将于3/11 3:00（ UTC/GMT: +8:00）进行版本更新，预计需要480分钟，本次更新将重启服务器，在线的探员将被强制下线，请提前下线避免损失！我们将在服务器开放后另行通知，对探员模拟训练带来的不便，敬请谅解！
本次更新将发放补偿：灵币x10000
【福利功能】
●福利功能：周免角色
本周免费体验角色
探员阵营：苏青鲤、尚香、嘉慧、夜罗、灵正英、葛永明
模拟怨灵阵营：聂小倩、于吉、勺子狂魔、小皮

【角色新增】
●全新灵探：如意
“咕咕咕~小鸽子如意来咯！”
如意是一位机动性很强的角色，可以变身成为鸽子和元素能量团，可以通过极致的伪装骗过模拟怨灵然后逃生。

【活动新增】
●限时特别宝匣：“星河入梦”
昭昭星河入梦，缕缕余音回响
活动时间：2023/3/10-2023/3/23
活动规则：1.在活动时间内集齐角色对应服饰即可兑换专属发色
                  2.司空星-星河回响系列、苏青鲤-入梦余音系列在星河入梦宝匣中获取
                  3.在星河入梦兑换活动中，累计抽取满500次可消耗抽取次数兑换一件星河入梦系列的任意一件服饰

●灵探如意限时角色礼包
“咕咕咕~小鸽子如意来咯！”
现已上线角色限定礼包，超值直购可享返利！
活动规则：1.活动期间直接购买既可获取如意以及礼包内角色套装
                  2.充值购买后立返等量价值灵石

●情人节天选兑换活动--“雪景待君Ⅱ”系列
“雪景待君，只因见卿“
活动时间：2023/3/10-2023/3/24
活动规则：1.在活动时间内集齐角色对应服饰即可兑换专属头像
                  2.装备全套即可激活专属待机动画

●绽灵商城上新：“特级探长”
“潜入黑夜，逆光前行”限时上架绽灵商城！
活动时间：2023/3/10-2023/3/31

●精武龙凤赛季兑换商城
赛季兑换商城开启，甄选皮肤任你挑！
  1）新增赛季币，赛季币可在赛季兑换商城兑换物品
  2）赛季兑换商城上架：总赛季宝匣、精武龙凤赛季宝匣、诡术宝匣、道具宝匣等多种物品
  3）赛季币可通过以下方式获得：灵石兑换、通行证升级、排位对局胜利、段位奖励总赛季宝匣奖励
  4）宝匣奖励说明：
     总赛季宝匣奖励：可获得往期高品质活动皮肤，详情请查看宝匣奖励列表。
     精武龙凤赛季宝匣奖励：
        灵探：乌栖枝-精武堂·烈凤系列
        怨灵：黑无常-精武·龙形系列、黑无常-精武·烈火（鬼雾）、黑无常-精武·金龙（武器）
  本次赛季精武龙凤主题专属皮肤，皮肤将会带有专属特效，怨灵鬼雾将会呈现火焰特效

●精武龙凤赛季上线 S2--精武龙凤
书绝龙庭羽，烽休凤穴戍
拂牖分龙影，临池待凤翔
1）全新赛季说明：
    1.全新赛季新开启，本次赛季更新后将从S2赛季重新计算。
    2.本次段位奖励升级，以名称精武龙凤为主题同步设计赛季主题皮肤，赛季及通行证皮肤为统一系列。
2）段位奖励新增
    1.灵探：乌栖枝-精武堂·橘炽系列、乌栖枝-精武·凤鸣（头饰）、赛季币、精武龙凤赛季限定特效头像框（皇）
    2.模拟怨灵：黑无常-精武堂·激斗（套）、黑无常-精武·解龙（武器）、赛季币、精武龙凤赛季限定特效头像框（帝）
3）排位对局奖励新增
    1.对局获胜后将会获得赛季币
    2.开通特级探员的玩家，即使排位比赛失败后也可获得赛季币

●精武龙凤-通行证上线
  通行证主题--精武龙凤，通行证付费版皮肤将会与赛季皮肤同步主题。
  本次通行证升级将会赠送各位玩家额外的100魂玉进行助力，希望大家能尽快的升级获得更多的奖励！
通行证全新升级调整：
     1）活动时间：系统开放时间 ~ 2023年6月1日00:00:00（包含服务器维护时间）
     2）通行证推出【免费版】和【尊享版】两条线路，最高等级为300级
     3）每升一级需要10个魂玉，提升通行证等级后，【免费版】奖励可直接领取，【尊享版】须直接购买解锁，解锁后，可获得丰厚奖励。
     4）通行证解锁方案共计两种：
          1.直接支付88元解锁【尊享版】
          2.花费128元购买【尊享版】和20个额外通行证等级
     5）通行证中获得的赛季币可前往赛季兑换商城兑换相应物品
     6）奖励升级
     【白嫖版】奖励升级后等级奖励可获得：头像、天赏宝匣、古币、碎玉、灵币、道具宝匣、诡术宝匣、赛季币
     【尊享版】奖励升级后等级奖励可额外获得：乌栖枝-精武堂·素水系列、黑无常-精武堂·磐龙系列、黑无常-精武·磐龙（武器）、精武龙凤赛季限定头像框银色、头像、天赏宝匣、古币、碎玉、灵币、道具宝匣、诡术宝匣、赛季币

●限时发色兑换：“玄灵少女”
“灵秘少女，内含玄机”
活动时间：2023/3/10-2023/3/17
活动规则：1.活动时间内抽取宝匣获取
                 2.集齐角色相对应服饰既可解锁专属待机动画
                 3.集齐对应角色服饰可兑换玄灵少女专属发色

【其他功能新增】
渔村地图和教堂地图现已加入排位模式

【试衣间新增】
星河入梦宝匣新增：司空星-星河回响系列、苏青鲤-入梦余音系列
绽灵宝匣新增：于吉-黑衣刑行者系列
天选宝匣新增：苏青鲤-瑞雪鹿卿-橙漫系列、何若瑶-瑞雪鹿卿-紫苑系列、纳兰莲舞-瑞雪鹿卿-青禾系列
赛季宝匣新增：乌栖枝-精武堂·烈凤系列、黑无常-精武·龙形系列、黑无常-精武·烈火（鬼雾）、黑无常-精武·金龙（武器）
赛季通行证新增：乌栖枝-精武堂·素水系列、黑无常-精武堂·磐龙系列、黑无常-精武·磐龙（武器）
赛季段位奖励新增：乌栖枝-精武堂·橘炽系列、黑无常-精武堂·激斗系列、乌栖枝-精武·凤鸣、黑无常-精武·解龙
角色礼包新增：如意-初遇系列
活动新增：玄灵少女兑换活动

【平衡调整】
1.略微增加了灵探晴红的主星技能冷却时间
2.略微降低了灵探晴红的主星技能持续时间
3.降低了灵探晴红使用主星技能后移动速度加成的持续时间
4.大幅度降低了灵探宁采臣使用主星技能后，被模拟怨灵击中后的减伤效果
5.增加了灵探嘉慧的血量上限
6.增加了灵探嘉慧的主星技能持续时间
7.降低了灵探嘉慧的主星技能冷却时间
8.增加了灵探嘉慧使用主星技能后的攻击范围
9.大幅度提高了灵探在被模拟怨灵小僵领域中的小小僵击中后附加的减速效果
10.提高了模拟怨灵德古拉的领域技能对灵探造成的减速效果

【问题修复】
1.修复了模拟怨灵于吉武器-乾坤逆可以分解的问题
2.修复了模拟怨灵黑无常的被动水影没有拆除UI的问题
3.修复了碎玉铸新活动页面，部分玩家在集齐苏青鲤-蝶舞翩翩时无法兑换苏青鲤-白裙映蝶的问题
4.修复了灵探宁采臣在使用主星技能时，利用技能的前摇会导致其无法收到攻击的问题
5.修复了灵探小冰携带武器-拳龙氏·冰晶时，对门使用主星技能后技能效果表现异常的问题
6.修复了新手教程中救人时会导致新手教程崩溃的问题

notes.title: 3/3 Wonderland version update announcement
notes.content:
Dear agent

The Lingjing system is expected to be updated at 17:30 on March 3 (UTC/GMT:+8:00). It is expected to take 120 minutes. This update will restart the server, and online agents will be forced to offline. Please offline in advance to avoid loss! We will notify you again after the server is opened. Please understand the inconvenience caused by the agent simulation training!

Compensation will be paid in this update: Lingcoin x10000

Benefit Function

● Welfare function: weekly exemption

Free role experience this week

Agent camp: Wu Qizhi, Aofeng, Jiahui, Qin Qiang, Ling Zhengying, Ge Yongming

Simulated resentment camp: Xiaopi, Yuji, Spoon Madness, Bai Qiulian



● Opening of time-limited welfare activities: "Blue Maggie"

"Today is another full day!"

Activity time: March 3, 2023 to March 31, 2023

Activity rules: You can get corresponding rewards by completing tasks within the activity period



[Add Activity]

● Time-limited tired charging activity is opened: "floating dreams"

"If the Southern Palace remembers the world, the green carp will float into the butterfly dream"

You can get it free of charge if the accumulated recharge reaches the standard!

Activity time: 2023/03/03-2023/03/31

Activity rules:

1. Recharge 3000/6000 RMB accumulatively during the activity time to unlock Nangong Yichen - Chufanchen, Su Qingli - Floating Dream hairstyle

2. After unlocking Nangong Yichen - Enter Fanchen, Su Qingli - Dream of Floating Life, you can use the corresponding currency to exchange other hair colors

3. The calculation of the cumulative recharge limit does not include the amount of the role gift package directly purchased by steam



● Time-limited theme treasure box: "Mysterious Girl"

Mysterious girl, containing mystery

Activity time: March 3, 2023 to March 17, 2023

Activity rules: 1. Draw treasure box during the activity time

2. Gather the corresponding costumes of the characters to unlock the exclusive standby animation

3. The whole set of clothes will be put on the shelf to receive the corresponding hair color exchange



[New fitting room]

New active activities in the month: Bian Que - Blue Maggie Series, Nalan Lian Dance - Soft Balloon "2"

The theme treasure box adds: Nangong Yichen - Xuanling Girl · Fansi Series, Wei Qingyu - Xuanling Girl · Jinhuan Series

Return of the Blooming Treasure Box: Nalan Lotus Dance - The Charm of the Dark Night Series, Nangong Yichen - The Desire of the White Night Series

Return of Tianxuan Treasure Box: Shangxiang - Incredible Lover Series, Xiaojuan - Yuyanjiali Series

Theme treasure box return: Xiaofang - ghost bride, Nalan - pure white flower wedding

Return of the event: exchange of Zhaoxue and Zhuwu



[Function Adjustment]

1. Adjust the sound size of all background sound effects in the game

2. Adjust the face kneading data layout method in the face kneading function

3. Adjusted the position of the pet, Xiaobing, to the upper left of the character



Balance adjustment

1. Greatly reduces the ability of the main star of the spirit probe, and stores the cooling time of each arrow

2. Reduces the shield damage reduction effect of teammates after the Spirit Detective Shang Xiang uses the main star skill to hit them

3. Reduces the damage reduction effect on the simulated grievance spirit caused by Spirit Detective Shang Xiang after hitting the simulated grievance spirit with the main star skill

4. The number of arrows stored in the main star skill of Spirit Detective Shangxiang has been increased to 8

5. Reduces the cooldown of the Spirit Detect Clear Red Master skill

6. Greatly increased the duration of the main star skill after Lingtan Qinghong used the main star skill

7. The increased movement speed of Lingtan Qinghong after crossing obstacles using the main star skill and the duration of the effect of movement speed increase have been increased.

8. Greatly increased the damage reduction effect after being hit by a simulated spirit after using the main star skill

9. Slightly reduces the physical strength consumed by Spirit Detective Manlin per second after using the main star skill to hit the simulated spirit or spirit scout

10. Slightly increased the movement speed and running speed of the spirit probe Qin Qiang

11. Increase the acceleration duration of using 1 skill to simulate the Grievance Zombie

12. Now Dracula can use 2 skills to place bats near the eye of the array

13. Improved the movement speed of Simulated Grievance Yuji when using 3 skills

14. Slightly reduced the movement speed of Yang Qilang when running

15. Slightly increased the physical consumption of Yang Qilang when running

16. Greatly increased the recovery speed of Yang Qilang's physical strength

17. Improved the flying speed of the bubble in the simulation of Feiling White autumn training



[Problem repair]

1. Fixed the problem that the speed hump formed after the simulation of the Snow-woman of the Complaining Spirit released 2 skills could not slow down the running spirit scout

2. Fixed the problem that the prompt of the spirit probe's interactive glass door was too small in the studio map and the simulation of the grievance spirit's eight-foot angle of view

notes.title: 《Spirit Detective》one year anniversary
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682815/bac8d809be34de570310093fd3b453b89ccc3010.png[/img]
Celebrate the first anniversary of 《Spirit Detective》 with the 1st Anniversary Celebration! This time, we're bringing you a whole bunch of new and different content to celebrate with our best agents. Along with this event, there will be a brand new Wraith character - Dracula, and the debut game mode - Expulsion Mode! Let's take a look together! 

[h1]Anniversary Event Reward Collection Route [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682815/1259aa9badb045448c3b088bacf0b652a9d5d450.png[/img]

This year, the reward routes we have prepared for the agents include 1*"2022 Anniversary" avatar frame, 1*"New Era" avatar, 1*Nalan Lian Dance-Dimensional Combat-Shoes, 1*Nalan Lian Dance-Dimensional Combat- Headgear, 1*Nalan Lotus Dance-Dimensional Combat-Facial, 1*Nalan Lotus Dance-Dimensional Combat-Bottoms, 1*Nalan Lotus Dance-Dimensional Combat-Tops Limited Skin. Below the agents can see the cosmetic items that can be obtained. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682815/4427ce1b93870d6f79ad6d568959c16a3a2e81d0.png[/img]

[h1]New Wraith Character - Dracula [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682815/2ea061c6d6acf6ae4009e092cfd302e61531d415.png[/img]

--Passive skill
Dracula is a high-level vampire, he can see the blood smell left by the wounded spirit detective, and can quickly attack it.
——Skill 1, Scarlet Guard
Dracula summons a bat in front of him, and the bat can see through the nearby spiritual detectives. At this time, Dracula can see through the bat in a certain range. Left-click to move to the bat position, and the spiritual detective can dismantle or attack to destroy the bat.
——Skill 2, Night Attack
Summons a group of bats at the designated location, obscuring the sight of the scouts, and the scouts within the range continue to deduct blood and be slowed down.
——Skill 3, ruthless pursuit
Launch - a group of bats fly forward, press the skill again to teleport to the bat's position.
- Domain Skills, Shadow Lord
Transform into a bat and fly, and you can release skills during flight.

[h1]Mall event discounts [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682815/3d5ac9913374ae6bbb8e5d1e2dc47f78c689decd.png[/img]

Agents remember to go to the store to see, we have launched a lot of special discounts on skins for you during the event. (See the game store for more discount details) 
[h3]Mall props discount package (2.7% off) ：[/h3]
Double EXP, Soul Coins Card, Rename Card (Gift Pack): Double Soul Coins Card*5, Double EXP Card*5, Double Intimacy Card*5, Rename Card*1, Soul Coins*88888, Ancient Coins* 8888 
[h3]Shopping mall package (super value and low price) ：[/h3]
Xiao Ming's limited gift package: 1. Fashion - Special Forces Southern Highlands - upper and lower shoe suits 2. Character Xiaoming
Shangxiang limited gift package: 1. Fashion - Goodbye Teenage Suit 2. Character Shangxiang
Small spider limited gift package: 1. Fashion - Sakura Xunqing suit 2. Character small spider 

[h1]The first game mode to appear - Exorcism Mode (stay tuned) [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39682815/7130d1d99204d115ca2134cba467da30427f2e00.png[/img]

An unusual virus attack occurred in the Spirit Detective system, and the agents participating in the training were infected by the virus and turned into puppets of grievances at the mercy of the virus. In order to solve this crisis, Ling Zhengying led the expulsion team to sneak into the spirit mirror system to find the origin of the virus. Can they successfully resolve this crisis? 

Finally, I would like to thank all the detectives for their long-term support. Hope to spend more anniversaries with all the detectives in the future. 

I wish you all good health and all the best on your journey! 

[h1]***Stay tuned for more***[/h1]

Dear Agent,
The update is expected to take 120 minutes at 0:00 (UTC/GMT: +8:00) on December 31. This update will restart the server, online agents will be forced to log off, please log off in advance to avoid loss! We will inform you later when the server is open.
